🧝 Pathfinder Character Builder

"Four boosts, no duplicates. Yes, every time."

Build a Pathfinder Second Edition character from Player Core 1 and 2 one step at a time: ancestry and heritage, background, class, attribute boosts, skills, and a feat at every feat level. The sheet works out your Hit Points, AC, saves, Perception, skills, Strikes, class DC, and spell slots from level 1 to 20, prints clean, and joins your party.

Everything stays in this browser: up to 30 Pathfinder characters, saved as you go, apart from your D&D ones. Export saves one as a file you can import on another device, or hand to your GM. 👥 Add to Party puts the character on the Party Tracker, where the encounter builder, initiative tracker, and GM Screen can use it.
Ancestries, heritages, backgrounds, classes, and feats are from Pathfinder Player Core and Player Core 2 by Paizo Inc., used under the ORC License. The proficiency table and the deity fields are the Gazette's own; no Golarion gods are named.

How the Pathfinder Character Builder works

Work through the steps in any order. Each one shows a red count of what's still to pick and a green check when it's done, and the sheet updates as you go. Change the level in the bar at any time: new boosts, skill increases, and feat slots show up on their steps.

What's in it

  • All 16 ancestries of Player Core 1 and 2 with their heritages, plus the versatile heritages (aiuvarin, dromaar, changeling, dhampir, dragonblood, duskwalker, nephilim).
  • The 63 core backgrounds and all 16 classes, each with its level-1 choice: instinct, muse, cause, doctrine, order, methodology, mystery, hunter's edge, racket, bloodline, style, patron, or arcane school and thesis.
  • Attribute boosts the Remaster way: ancestry (or two free boosts and no flaw), background, your key attribute, four free boosts at 1st level and every fifth level, with partial boosts past +4.
  • Skills with their ranks: training from your class, background, and class choice, then skill increases to expert, master, and legendary at the levels the rules allow.
  • About 1,800 feats: ancestry, class, skill, general, and archetype feats, each with its full rules text and prerequisites.

What it adds up, and what it leaves to you

The sheet works out Hit Points, AC from your armor and its potency rune, Speed, Perception, Fortitude, Reflex, Will, every skill and Lore, class DC, Strikes with the multiple attack penalty and striking runes, and spell DC and slots. Feats and class features are listed with their text, but their effects (Toughness's extra Hit Points, a stance's bonus) aren't added in: write them into your play. For deities, the Gazette lists no gods by name, so give yours a name and pick its skill, favored weapon, and font.

Works with

Send the character to the Party Tracker, then run fights in the Initiative Tracker and balance them with the Encounter Builder. Check a Strike's odds against a creature's AC in the Attack Calculator, and look up spells in the spell list.
